products.name: 30th Celebration
products.summary: The anniversary set. Thirty packs of six, and the single most chased Japanese release of the year.
products.detail: Allocation confirmed with our Tokyo supplier and split between trade and retail. Six cards per pack rather than the usual five, with the special anniversary card pool running through the whole print. Reserve now — we do not expect a second allocation before the new year.

products.name: Magnetic Acrylic Case
products.dispatch: In the vault — dispatched within 48 hours
products.summary: UV-filtered acrylic with a magnetic closure, cut for a standard booster display.
products.detail: Our own line. Four-millimetre UV-filtering acrylic, a magnetic closure rather than a slide fit, and a felt base so the box does not scuff. Protection worth putting a £215 display behind.
